verses.sloka: वधमप्रतिरूपम् तु महर्षेस्तस्य राघवः ।विलपन्ने व धर्मात्मा कौसल्याम् पुन रब्रवीत् ॥२-६४-१॥
verses.transliteration: vadhamapratirūpam tu maharṣestasya rāghavaḥ ।vilapanne va dharmātmā kausalyām puna rabravīt ॥2-64-1॥

translations.english: Grieving for having unfairly killed the great sage the rightenous descendant of the Raghus (Dasaratha) coutinued to tell Kausalya about it:
translations.hindi: B— द्विषष्टितमः सगः =°: एवं तु क्रद्यया राजा राममात्रा सशोकया। - श्रावितः परुषं वाक्मं चिन्तयामास दुःखितः

verses.sloka: तत् अज्ञानान् महत् पापम् कृत्वा सम्कुलित इन्द्रियः ।एकः तु अचिन्तयम् बुद्ध्या कथम् नु सुकृतम् भवेत् ॥२-६४-२॥
verses.transliteration: tat ajñānān mahat pāpam kṛtvā samkulita indriyaḥ ।ekaḥ tu acintayam buddhyā katham nu sukṛtam bhavet ॥2-64-2॥

translations.english: Having committed the sin unwittingly, I was greatly agitated. I reflected in my mind as to how to atone for this great sin.
translations.hindi: यही सोचते सोचते महाराज बिकल हो मूर्छित हो गए और बहुत देर बाद वे सचेत हुए

verses.sloka: ततः तम् घटम् आदय पूर्णम् परम वारिणा ।आश्रमम् तम् अहम् प्राप्य यथा आख्यात पथम् गतः ॥२-६४-३॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tam ghaṭam ādaya pūrṇam parama vāriṇā ।āśramam tam aham prāpya yathā ākhyāta patham gataḥ ॥2-64-3॥

translations.english: Holding the pot filled with clean water I reached the hermitage following the path as directed.

verses.sloka: तत्र अहम् दुर्बलाव् अन्धौ वृद्धाव् अपरिणायकौ ।अपश्यम् तस्य पितरौ लून पक्षाव् इव द्विजौ ॥२-६४-४॥
verses.transliteration: tatra aham durbalāv andhau vṛddhāv apariṇāyakau ।apaśyam tasya pitarau lūna pakṣāv iva dvijau ॥2-64-4॥

translations.english: There I found his weak, blind, old parents. With no supporter, they looked like birds with clipped wings. They sat there helplessly like orphans and passively talking about their son, their only hope that I have deprived them of.
translations.hindi: सोचते-सोचते उनको अपना ( पूर्वेक्ृत ) एक पाप कर्म याद्‌ पड़ा । ( वह था ) पहले किसी समय अनजाने एक तपस्वी का शब्दवेधी बाण से वध

verses.sloka: तन् निमित्ताभिर् आसीनौ कथाभिर् अपरिक्रमौ ।ताम् आशाम् मत् कृते हीनाव् उदासीनाव् अनाथवत् ॥२-६४-५॥
verses.transliteration: tan nimittābhir āsīnau kathābhir aparikramau ।tām āśām mat kṛte hīnāv udāsīnāv anāthavat ॥2-64-5॥

translations.english: There I found his weak, blind, old parents. With no supporter, they looked like birds with clipped wings. They sat there helplessly like orphans and passively talking about their son, their only hope that I have deprived them of.
translations.hindi: हे कोमल्ये ! मैं बनती करता हूं शौर हाथ जोड़ता हूं। तू तो अपने शत्रुओं पर भी सरा दया दिखाती, और उनके प्रति भी अकठार व्यवहार करती है

verses.sloka: शोकोपहतचित्तश्च भयसम्त्रस्तचेतनः ।तच्चाश्रमपदम् गत्वा भूयः शोकमहम् गतः ॥२-६४-६॥
verses.transliteration: śokopahatacittaśca bhayasamtrastacetanaḥ ।taccāśramapadam gatvā bhūyaḥ śokamaham gataḥ ॥2-64-6॥

translations.english: Smitten with grief and my heart throbbing with fear I reached the hermitage and my sorrow became manifold.
translations.hindi: इन दोनां शोकं से दग्ध और दुःखित महाराज दशरथ ने, कॉप कर और नोचा मिर कर, कोमल्या को प्रसन्न करने. के उद्देश्य से हाथ जोइकर, कहा

verses.sloka: पद शब्दम् तु मे श्रुत्वा मुनिर् वाक्यम् अभाषत ।किम् चिरायसि मे पुत्र पानीयम् क्षिप्रम् आनय ॥२-६४-७॥
verses.transliteration: pada śabdam tu me śrutvā munir vākyam abhāṣata ।kim cirāyasi me putra pānīyam kṣipram ānaya ॥2-64-7॥

translations.english: Hearing the sound of my footsteps, the sage said 'O son why have you delayed? Bring me some water quickly'.

verses.sloka: यन् निमित्तम् इदम् तात सलिले क्रीडितम् त्वया ।उत्कण्ठिता ते माता इयम् प्रविश क्षिप्रम् आश्रमम् ॥२-६४-८॥
verses.transliteration: yan nimittam idam tāta salile krīḍitam tvayā ।utkaṇṭhitā te mātā iyam praviśa kṣipram āśramam ॥2-64-8॥

translations.english: 'O Dear child, whatever be the reason, you have been sporting in the water so long, come at once to the hermitage. Your mother is anxious.
translations.hindi: हे दांव ! (यह भरी तू जानती ही है कि) धर्म की दृष्टि से, धर्माचरण करने वाली स्त्री के लिए उसका पति ही चाहे गुणी हो अथवा निगु णी, प्रत्य त्त देवता है

verses.sloka: यद् व्यलीकम् कृतम् पुत्र मात्रा ते यदि वा मया ।न तन् मनसि कर्तव्यम् त्वया तात तपस्विना ॥२-६४-९॥
verses.transliteration: yad vyalīkam kṛtam putra mātrā te yadi vā mayā ।na tan manasi kartavyam tvayā tāta tapasvinā ॥2-64-9॥

translations.english: 'O Child, O Son if your mother or I have done anything disagreeable, do not take it to heart, for you are an ascetic.

verses.sloka: त्वम् गतिस् तु अगतीनाम् च चक्षुस् त्वम् हीन चक्षुषाम् ।समासक्ताः त्वयि प्राणाः किम्चिन् नौ न अभिभाषसे ॥२-६४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tvam gatis tu agatīnām ca cakṣus tvam hīna cakṣuṣām ।samāsaktāḥ tvayi prāṇāḥ kimcin nau na abhibhāṣase ॥2-64-10॥

translations.english: 'You are a support to the supportless, eyes to the blind, you are our very vital life. Why don't you speak to us'?
translations.hindi: महाराज के ऐसे “करुणापूर्ण बचन सुन, कौसल्या के नेत्रों से आँसुओं की धार उसी भाँति बही, जिस भाँति नालियों में | ` वष । का जल बहता है

verses.sloka: मुनिम् अव्यक्तया वाचा तम् अहम् सज्जमानया ।हीन व्यन्जनया प्रेक्ष्य भीतः भीतैव अब्रुवम् ॥२-६४-११॥
verses.transliteration: munim avyaktayā vācā tam aham sajjamānayā ।hīna vyanjanayā prekṣya bhītaḥ bhītaiva abruvam ॥2-64-11॥

translations.english: As I saw him, my heart was filled with terror and I stammered as I spoke in garbled sentences.
translations.hindi: कौसल्या ने महाराज के दोनों जुड़े हुए कमल सरश हाथों को अपने[सिर पर रख लिआ और रोती हुई तथा घवड़ाती सी वह बोली

verses.sloka: मनसः कर्म चेष्टाभिर् अभिसम्स्तभ्य वाग् बलम् ।आचचक्षे तु अहम् तस्मै पुत्र व्यसनजम् भयम् ॥२-६४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: manasaḥ karma ceṣṭābhir abhisamstabhya vāg balam ।ācacakṣe tu aham tasmai putra vyasanajam bhayam ॥2-64-12॥

translations.english: After a lot of effort, with great fear controlling my thoughts and the power of speech, I related to him the calamity that had befallen his son.
translations.hindi: हे देव ! तुम दुःखी न हो, प्रसन्न हो ।मैं प्रपना सिर तुम्हारे चरणों में रख तुमको प्रणाम करती हूँ । तुम्हारा मेरी विनती , करना, मेरे लिए मरने के समान कप्टदाथी हे । अतः आप मुझसे क्षमा माँग कर, मेरे अनुचित कथन फे लिए मुझे दंड दें

verses.sloka: क्षत्रियो अहम् दशरथो न अहम् पुत्रः महात्मनः ।सज्जन अवमतम् दुह्खम् इदम् प्राप्तम् स्व कर्मजम् ॥२-६४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyo aham daśaratho na aham putraḥ mahātmanaḥ ।sajjana avamatam duhkham idam prāptam sva karmajam ॥2-64-13॥

translations.english: O magnanimous sage I am a kshatriya known as Dasaratha. I am not your son. A pathetic incident has been caused by my own action, condemnable by the virtuous.

verses.sloka: भगवमः च अपहस्तः अहम् सरयू तीरम् आगतः ।जिघाम्सुः श्वा पदम् किम्चिन् निपाने वा आगतम् गजम् ॥२-६४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavamaḥ ca apahastaḥ aham sarayū tīram āgataḥ ।jighāmsuḥ śvā padam kimcin nipāne vā āgatam gajam ॥2-64-14॥

translations.english: Wishing to hunt a wild elephant coming down to the water hole for drinking, I went to the bank of Sarayu, bow in hand, O revered sage
translations.hindi: हे धर्मज्ञ ! मैं ्जीकत्तव्य को जानती हूँ और तुमको सत्यवादी मानती हूँ । उस समय मेरे मुख से जो थोड़ा बहुत अनुचित निकल गया, उसका कारण पुत्रशोक है

verses.sloka: ततः श्रुतः मया शब्दो जले कुम्भस्य पूर्यतः ।द्विपो अयम् इति मत्वा हि बाणेन अभिहतः मया ॥२-६४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrutaḥ mayā śabdo jale kumbhasya pūryataḥ ।dvipo ayam iti matvā hi bāṇena abhihataḥ mayā ॥2-64-15॥

translations.english: There I heard the sound of a pot being filled with water and mistaking it to be an elephant's, shot an arrow.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि शोक (मनुष्य कौ केवल ) घैय और शा्ञज्ञान ही नष्ट नहीं करता, प्रत्युत सर्वनाश कर देता है । अतः शोक से बढ़कर (मनुष्य का ) शत्रु दूसरा कोई नहीं है

verses.sloka: गत्वा नद्याः ततः तीरम् अपश्यम् इषुणा हृदि ।विनिर्भिन्नम् गत प्राणम् शयानम् भुवि तापसम् ॥२-६४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: gatvā nadyāḥ tataḥ tīram apaśyam iṣuṇā hṛdi ।vinirbhinnam gata prāṇam śayānam bhuvi tāpasam ॥2-64-16॥

translations.english: Thereafter I reached the river bank and beheld an ascetic with an arrow pierced in his chest. He was lying on the ground, his life ebbing away.
translations.hindi: अतएव अन्य बैरी के हाथ का प्रहार तो सह भी लिश्रा जा सकता है, किन्तु हठा-्राप्त बहुत थोड़ा|सा भी शोक, नहीं सहा जा सकता

verses.sloka: भगवन् शब्दम् आलक्ष्य मया गज जिघाम्सुना ।विसृष्टः अम्भसि नाराचः तेन ते निहतः सुतः ॥२-६४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavan śabdam ālakṣya mayā gaja jighāmsunā ।visṛṣṭaḥ ambhasi nārācaḥ tena te nihataḥ sutaḥ ॥2-64-17॥

translations.english: O venerable one I released an arrow towards the water aiming at the sound intending to kill an elephant but it hit your son.
translations.hindi: श्रुतम्‌-शास्त्रश्रवणजनितनिश्चतषमे | (शि०) २ आपतितः हठातूप्राप्तः । ( गो० ) “डे रास वो वनवास गए आज पांचवीं रात है किन्तु, मेरे लिए तो ये पांच वर्षों के समान हैं। क्योंकि राम-वियोग- जनित शोक के कारण हष तो एकदम मुभसे विदा हो गया है

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्यैव वचनादुपेत्य परितप्यतः ।स मया सहसा बण उद्धृतो मर्मतस्तदा ॥२-६४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tatastasyaiva vacanādupetya paritapyataḥ ।sa mayā sahasā baṇa uddhṛto marmatastadā ॥2-64-18॥

translations.english: Then I approached him. He was suffering from excruciating pain. I pulled out at his word the arrow from his chest.
translations.hindi: राम की चिन्ता करने से मेरे हृदय में उसी प्रकार शोक बढ्ता है, जिस प्रकार नदी के जल के वेग से समुद्र का जल बढ्ता है

verses.sloka: स च उद्धृतेन बाणेन तत्र एव स्वर्गम् आस्थितः ।भगवन्ताव् उभौ शोचन्न् अन्धाव् इति विलप्य च ॥२-६४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca uddhṛtena bāṇena tatra eva svargam āsthitaḥ ।bhagavantāv ubhau śocann andhāv iti vilapya ca ॥2-64-19॥

translations.english: Grieving for both of you and crying you are blind he died as soon as the arrow was pulled out.

verses.sloka: अज्ञानात् भवतः पुत्रः सहसा अभिहतः मया ।शेषम् एवम् गते यत् स्यात् तत् प्रसीदतु मे मुनिः ॥२-६४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: ajñānāt bhavataḥ putraḥ sahasā abhihataḥ mayā ।śeṣam evam gate yat syāt tat prasīdatu me muniḥ ॥2-64-20॥

translations.english: Your son has been killed by me due to my ignorance. Since this has happened, may the ascetic be pleased to command me on the next course of action.
translations.hindi: इति द्विषष्टितमः सगः || महाराज दशरथ, कौसल्या की यह बातचीत सुन, हर्षित हुए ओर शोक से उत्पीडित होने के कारण उनको नींद आ गई

verses.sloka: स तत् श्रुत्वा वचः क्रूरम् निह्श्वसन् शोक कर्शितः ।नाशकत्तीव्रमायासमकर्तुम् भगवानृषिः ॥२-६४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: sa tat śrutvā vacaḥ krūram nihśvasan śoka karśitaḥ ।nāśakattīvramāyāsamakartum bhagavānṛṣiḥ ॥2-64-21॥

translations.english: The venerable sage heard my cruel words about the sinful act and was not able to seriously react. (He was stunned).

verses.sloka: सबाष्पपूर्णवदनो निःश्वसन् शोककर्शितः ।माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम् ॥२-६४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sabāṣpapūrṇavadano niḥśvasan śokakarśitaḥ ।mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam ॥2-64-22॥

translations.english: The griefstricken, glorious ascetic with his face filled with tears, heaving deep sighs broke down with grief and spoke to me as I was standing with folded palms.

verses.sloka: यद्य् एतत् अशुभम् कर्म न स्म मे कथयेः स्वयम् ।फलेन् मूर्धा स्म ते राजन् सद्यः शत सहस्रधा ॥२-६४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: yady etat aśubham karma na sma me kathayeḥ svayam ।phalen mūrdhā sma te rājan sadyaḥ śata sahasradhā ॥2-64-23॥

translations.english: 'O king, hadn't you yourself broken this inauspicious news, your head would have split into a hundred thousand pieces right now.

verses.sloka: क्षत्रियेण वधो राजन् वानप्रस्थे विशेषतः ।ज्ञान पूर्वम् कृतः स्थानाच् च्यावयेद् अपि वज्रिणम् ॥२-६४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyeṇa vadho rājan vānaprasthe viśeṣataḥ ।jñāna pūrvam kṛtaḥ sthānāc cyāvayed api vajriṇam ॥2-64-24॥

translations.english: 'If a kshatriya kills any one knowingly, particularly when in vanaprastha (third stage) this sin can displace even Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt from his position, O king.

verses.sloka: सप्तधा तु फलेन्मूर्धा मुनौ तपसि तिष्ठति ।ज्ञानाद्विसृजतः शस्त्रम् तादृशे ब्रह्मचारिणि ॥२-६४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: saptadhā tu phalenmūrdhā munau tapasi tiṣṭhati ।jñānādvisṛjataḥ śastram tādṛśe brahmacāriṇi ॥2-64-25॥

translations.english: 'If any one deliberately discharges a weapon upon an ascetic observing austerities or on him who expounds the Vedas, his head will split into seven pieces.

verses.sloka: अज्ञानाद्द् हि कृतम् यस्मात् इदम् तेन एव जीवसि ।अपि हि अद्य कुलम् नस्यात् राघवाणाम् कुतः भवान् ॥२-६४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: ajñānādd hi kṛtam yasmāt idam tena eva jīvasi ।api hi adya kulam nasyāt rāghavāṇām kutaḥ bhavān ॥2-64-26॥

translations.english: 'Since you have done this unwittingly you are still alive. If it had been otherwise, your Ikshvaku race itself would have been exterminated, what to speak of you

verses.sloka: नय नौ नृप तम् देशम् इति माम् च अभ्यभाषत ।अद्य तम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चावः पुत्रम् पश्चिम दर्शनम् ॥२-६४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: naya nau nṛpa tam deśam iti mām ca abhyabhāṣata ।adya tam draṣṭum iccāvaḥ putram paścima darśanam ॥2-64-27॥

translations.english: 'O king take us to that place. We wish to have the last look at him, at his garment of antelope skin in disarray, his body spattered with blood, lying on the ground unconscious under the sway of the lord of death'. Thus the sage said to me.

verses.sloka: रुधिरेण अवसित अन्गम् प्रकीर्ण अजिन वाससम् ।शयानम् भुवि निह्सम्ज्ञम् धर्म राज वशम् गतम् ॥२-६४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: rudhireṇa avasita angam prakīrṇa ajina vāsasam ।śayānam bhuvi nihsamjñam dharma rāja vaśam gatam ॥2-64-28॥

translations.english: 'O king take us to that place. We wish to have the last look at him, at his garment of antelope skin in disarray, his body spattered with blood, lying on the ground unconscious under the sway of the lord of death'. Thus the sage said to me.

verses.sloka: अथ अहम् एकः तम् देशम् नीत्वा तौ भृश दुह्खितौ ।अस्पर्शयम् अहम् पुत्रम् तम् मुनिम् सह भार्यया ॥२-६४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: atha aham ekaḥ tam deśam nītvā tau bhṛśa duhkhitau ।asparśayam aham putram tam munim saha bhāryayā ॥2-64-29॥

translations.english: Thereupon, I took both of them all by myself to that spot and made the grieving ascetics touch the body of their son.

verses.sloka: तौ पुत्रम् आत्मनः स्पृष्ट्वा तम् आसाद्य तपस्विनौ ।निपेततुः शरीरे अस्य पिता च अस्य इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tau putram ātmanaḥ spṛṣṭvā tam āsādya tapasvinau ।nipetatuḥ śarīre asya pitā ca asya idam abravīt ॥2-64-30॥

translations.english: Both the ascetics stroking their son's body and collapsed upon it. And the father said:

verses.sloka: न न्व् अहम् ते प्रियः पुत्र मातरम् पश्य धार्मिक ।किम् नु न आलिन्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद ॥२-६४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: na nv aham te priyaḥ putra mātaram paśya dhārmika ।kim nu na ālingase putra sukumāra vaco vada ॥2-64-31॥

translations.english: 'O child why are you not greeting us today nor speaking? Why are you lying on the ground? Are you angry with us?

verses.sloka: न त्वहम् ते प्रियः पुत्र मातरम् पस्य धार्मिक ।किम् नु नालिङ्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद ॥२-६४-३२॥
verses.transliteration: na tvaham te priyaḥ putra mātaram pasya dhārmika ।kim nu nāliṅgase putra sukumāra vaco vada ॥2-64-32॥

translations.english: 'O righteous son if I am no longer dear to you, (at least) look at your mother. O tender child, why are you not embracing me? Speak.

verses.sloka: कस्य वा अपर रात्रे अहम् श्रोष्यामि हृदयम् गमम् ।अधीयानस्य मधुरम् शास्त्रम् वा अन्यद् विशेषतः ॥२-६४-३३॥
verses.transliteration: kasya vā apara rātre aham śroṣyāmi hṛdayam gamam ।adhīyānasya madhuram śāstram vā anyad viśeṣataḥ ॥2-64-33॥

translations.english: 'From whom shall I hear the sweet recitation of scriptures or other texts, delightful to my heart in the last watch of the night?

verses.sloka: को माम् सम्ध्याम् उपास्य एव स्नात्वा हुत हुत अशनः ।श्लाघयिष्यति उपासीनः पुत्र शोक भय अर्दितम् ॥२-६४-३४॥
verses.transliteration: ko mām samdhyām upāsya eva snātvā huta huta aśanaḥ ।ślāghayiṣyati upāsīnaḥ putra śoka bhaya arditam ॥2-64-34॥

translations.english: 'O son I am tortured with sorrow and fear. Who will serve me from now on after the ablution and the morning worship of Sandhya, followed by oblations to the sacrificial fire?

verses.sloka: कन्द मूल फलम् हृत्वा को माम् प्रियम् इव अतिथिम् ।भोजयिष्यति अकर्मण्यम् अप्रग्रहम् अनायकम् ॥२-६४-३५॥
verses.transliteration: kanda mūla phalam hṛtvā ko mām priyam iva atithim ।bhojayiṣyati akarmaṇyam apragraham anāyakam ॥2-64-35॥

translations.english: 'I am incapable of doing any work, I am unable to procure anything (to meet my needs. now). I have no guide (to help me walk my way). Who will feed me like a welcome guest with tubers and fruits?

verses.sloka: इमाम् अन्धाम् च वृद्धाम् च मातरम् ते तपस्विनीम् ।कथम् पुत्र भरिष्यामि कृपणाम् पुत्र गर्धिनीम् ॥२-६४-३६॥
verses.transliteration: imām andhām ca vṛddhām ca mātaram te tapasvinīm ।katham putra bhariṣyāmi kṛpaṇām putra gardhinīm ॥2-64-36॥

translations.english: 'O son how can I support your wretched and pitiable mother, who is blind, old and yearning for her son?

verses.sloka: तिष्ठ मा मा गमः पुत्र यमस्य सदनम् प्रति ।श्वो मया सह गन्ता असि जनन्या च समेधितः ॥२-६४-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha mā mā gamaḥ putra yamasya sadanam prati ।śvo mayā saha gantā asi jananyā ca samedhitaḥ ॥2-64-37॥

translations.english: 'My dear son, stay with me, do not go (now) to the abode of Yama, (lord of death). Tomorrow accompanied by me and your mother you may

verses.sloka: उभाव् अपि च शोक आर्ताव् अनाथौ कृपणौ वने ।क्षिप्रम् एव गमिष्यावः त्वया हीनौ यम क्षयम् ॥२-६४-३८॥
verses.transliteration: ubhāv api ca śoka ārtāv anāthau kṛpaṇau vane ।kṣipram eva gamiṣyāvaḥ tvayā hīnau yama kṣayam ॥2-64-38॥

translations.english: 'Deserted by you and without any support in the forest, afflicted with grief and feeling miserable, both of us also will assuredly go to Yama's abode, quickly.

verses.sloka: ततः वैवस्वतम् दृष्ट्वा तम् प्रवक्ष्यामि भारतीम् ।क्षमताम् धर्म राजो मे बिभृयात् पितराव् अयम् ॥२-६४-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ vaivasvatam dṛṣṭvā tam pravakṣyāmi bhāratīm ।kṣamatām dharma rājo me bibhṛyāt pitarāv ayam ॥2-64-39॥

translations.english: 'There seeing Yama, (lord of death), I shall say O Lord of Justice forgive me. Let this boy continue to maintain his parents.

verses.sloka: दातुमर्हति धर्मात्मा लोकपालो महायशाः ।ईदृषस्य ममाक्षय्या मेकामभयदक्षिणाम् ॥२-६४-४०॥
verses.transliteration: dātumarhati dharmātmā lokapālo mahāyaśāḥ ।īdṛṣasya mamākṣayyā mekāmabhayadakṣiṇām ॥2-64-40॥

translations.english: 'That lord of justice, who is highly renowned, righteous and the guardian of the worlds will grant me one unfailing boon of protection from fear.

verses.sloka: अपापो असि यथा पुत्र निहतः पाप कर्मणा ।तेन सत्येन गच्च आशु ये लोकाः शस्त्र योधिनाम् ॥२-६४-४१॥
verses.transliteration: apāpo asi yathā putra nihataḥ pāpa karmaṇā ।tena satyena gacca āśu ye lokāḥ śastra yodhinām ॥2-64-41॥

translations.english: 'O sinless son, you are killed by a person of sinful deeds. On this truth, quickly go to those worlds which are attained by those valiant heroes.

verses.sloka: यान्ति शूरा गतिम् याम् च सम्ग्रामेष्व् अनिवर्तिनः ।हताः तु अभिमुखाः पुत्र गतिम् ताम् परमाम् व्रज ॥२-६४-४२॥
verses.transliteration: yānti śūrā gatim yām ca samgrāmeṣv anivartinaḥ ।hatāḥ tu abhimukhāḥ putra gatim tām paramām vraja ॥2-64-42॥

translations.english: O son, attain that supreme goal which brave warriors, who never retreat but fall facing the foe in battle, attain.

verses.sloka: याम् गतिम् सगरः शैब्यो दिलीपो जनमेजयः ।नहुषो धुन्धुमारः च प्राप्ताः ताम् गच्च पुत्रक ॥२-६४-४३॥
verses.transliteration: yām gatim sagaraḥ śaibyo dilīpo janamejayaḥ ।nahuṣo dhundhumāraḥ ca prāptāḥ tām gacca putraka ॥2-64-43॥

translations.english: 'You will attain, my son, the same supreme state achieved by Sagara, Saibya, Dilipa, Janamejaya, Nahusha and Dundumara.

verses.sloka: या गतिः सर्व साधूनाम् स्वाध्यायात् पतसः च या ।भूमिदस्य आहित अग्नेः चएक पत्नी व्रतस्य च ॥२-६४-४४॥
verses.transliteration: yā gatiḥ sarva sādhūnām svādhyāyāt patasaḥ ca yā ।bhūmidasya āhita agneḥ caeka patnī vratasya ca ॥2-64-44॥

translations.english: 'You, my son, shall attain that supreme state obtained by those who are virtuous, who study the Vedas and practise asceticism.You shall attain the state merited by those bestowers of land as charity, who kindle the sacred fires, who are monoganists, who offer a thousand cows in charity, who nurture the venerable and who willingly lay down their bodies.

verses.sloka: गो सहस्र प्रदातृऋणाम् या या गुरुभृताम् अपि ।देह न्यास कृताम् या च ताम् गतिम् गच्च पुत्रक ॥२-६४-४५॥
verses.transliteration: go sahasra pradātṛṛṇām yā yā gurubhṛtām api ।deha nyāsa kṛtām yā ca tām gatim gacca putraka ॥2-64-45॥

translations.english: 'You, my son, shall attain that supreme state obtained by those who are virtuous, who study the Vedas and practise asceticism.You shall attain the state merited by those bestowers of land as charity, who kindle the sacred fires, who are monoganists, who offer a thousand cows in charity, who nurture the venerable and who willingly lay down their bodies.

verses.sloka: न हि तु अस्मिन् कुले जातः गच्चति अकुशलाम् गतिम् ।स तु यास्यति येन त्वम् निहतो मम बान्धवः ॥२-६४-४६॥
verses.transliteration: na hi tu asmin kule jātaḥ gaccati akuśalām gatim ।sa tu yāsyati yena tvam nihato mama bāndhavaḥ ॥2-64-46॥

translations.english: 'He who has killed you will alone attain that undesirable state, a member of our family will not.'

verses.sloka: एवम् स कृपणम् तत्र पर्यदेवयत असकृत् ।ततः अस्मै कर्तुम् उदकम् प्रवृत्तः सह भार्यया ॥२-६४-४७॥
verses.transliteration: evam sa kṛpaṇam tatra paryadevayata asakṛt ।tataḥ asmai kartum udakam pravṛttaḥ saha bhāryayā ॥2-64-47॥

translations.english: In this way the ascetic piteously wailed again and again. Thereafter, he with his wife set about to perform the funeral obsequies of their son.

verses.sloka: स तु दिव्येन रूपेण मुनि पुत्रः स्व कर्मभिः ।स्वर्गमाध्यारुहत् ख्षिप्रम् शक्रेण सह खर्मवित् ॥२-६४-४८॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu divyena rūpeṇa muni putraḥ sva karmabhiḥ ।svargamādhyāruhat khṣipram śakreṇa saha kharmavit ॥2-64-48॥

translations.english: The virtuous son of that ascetic assumed a celestial form through the merit of his good deeds and ascended heaven at once with Indra.

verses.sloka: आबभाषे च वृद्धौ तौ सह शक्रेण तापसः ।आश्वास्य च मुहूर्तम् तु पितरौ वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६४-४९॥
verses.transliteration: ābabhāṣe ca vṛddhau tau saha śakreṇa tāpasaḥ ।āśvāsya ca muhūrtam tu pitarau vākyam abravīt ॥2-64-49॥

translations.english: The ascetic in the company of Indra consoling the aged couple for a brief moment said:

verses.sloka: स्थानम् अस्मि महत् प्राप्तः भवतोह् परिचारणात् ।भवन्ताव् अपि च क्षिप्रम् मम मूलम् उपैष्यतः ॥२-६४-५०॥
verses.transliteration: sthānam asmi mahat prāptaḥ bhavatoh paricāraṇāt ।bhavantāv api ca kṣipram mama mūlam upaiṣyataḥ ॥2-64-50॥

translations.english: 'I have attained this supreme state by virtue of the service rendered to you. You will also attain my state soon.'

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु दिव्येन विमानेन वपुष्मता ।आरुरोह दिवम् क्षिप्रम् मुनि पुत्रः जित इन्द्रियः ॥२-६४-५१॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu divyena vimānena vapuṣmatā ।āruroha divam kṣipram muni putraḥ jita indriyaḥ ॥2-64-51॥

translations.english: The sage's son with his senses under control said this while ascending heaven on a beautiful, celestial, aerial chariot.

verses.sloka: स कृत्वा तु उदकम् तूर्णम् तापसः सह भार्यया ।माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम् ॥२-६४-५२॥
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā tu udakam tūrṇam tāpasaḥ saha bhāryayā ।mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam ॥2-64-52॥

translations.english: The radiant ascetic along with his wife hurriedly completed the funeral libations and said to me standing with folded palms:

verses.sloka: अद्य एव जहि माम् राजन् मरणे न अस्ति मे व्यथा ।यत् शरेण एक पुत्रम् माम् त्वम् अकार्षीर् अपुत्रकम् ॥२-६४-५३॥
verses.transliteration: adya eva jahi mām rājan maraṇe na asti me vyathā ।yat śareṇa eka putram mām tvam akārṣīr aputrakam ॥2-64-53॥

translations.english: 'Kill me, O king with the same arrow by which you rendered me childless. Death holds no pain for me.

verses.sloka: त्वया तु यद् अविज्ञानान् निहतः मे सुतः शुचिः ।तेन त्वाम् अभिशप्स्यामि सुदुह्खम् अतिदारुणम् ॥२-६४-५४॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā tu yad avijñānān nihataḥ me sutaḥ śuciḥ ।tena tvām abhiśapsyāmi suduhkham atidāruṇam ॥2-64-54॥

translations.english: 'Though you have killed my purehearted son unintentionally, I will pronounce a disastrous and dreadful curse on you.

verses.sloka: पुत्र व्यसनजम् दुह्खम् यद् एतन् मम साम्प्रतम् ।एवम् त्वम् पुत्र शोकेन राजन् कालम् करिष्यसि ॥२-६४-५५॥
verses.transliteration: putra vyasanajam duhkham yad etan mama sāmpratam ।evam tvam putra śokena rājan kālam kariṣyasi ॥2-64-55॥

translations.english: 'Just as I am now suffering from grief caused by my son's death, you, O king, shall die from the sorrow on account of (separation from) your son.

verses.sloka: अज्ञानात्तु हतो यस्मात् क्षत्रियेण त्वया मुनिः ।तस्मात्त्वाम् नाविशत्याशु ब्रह्महत्या नराधिप ॥२-६४-५६॥
verses.transliteration: ajñānāttu hato yasmāt kṣatriyeṇa tvayā muniḥ ।tasmāttvām nāviśatyāśu brahmahatyā narādhipa ॥2-64-56॥

translations.english: 'Since you, O lord of men, you have killed an ascetic unaware, as kshatriya the sin of slaying a brahmin will not accrue to you immediately.

verses.sloka: त्वामप्येतादृशो भावः क्षिप्रमेव गमिष्यति ।जीवितान्तकरो घोरो दातारमिव दक्षिणा ॥२-६४-५७॥
verses.transliteration: tvāmapyetādṛśo bhāvaḥ kṣiprameva gamiṣyati ।jīvitāntakaro ghoro dātāramiva dakṣiṇā ॥2-64-57॥

translations.english: 'Just like the merits of alms come to the giver, you are going to face very soon a dreadful situation causing the end of your life.'

verses.sloka: एवम् शापम् मयि न्यस्य विलप्य करुणम् बहु ।चितामारोप्य देहम् तन्मिथुनम् स्वर्गमभ्ययात् ॥२-६४-५८॥
verses.transliteration: evam śāpam mayi nyasya vilapya karuṇam bahu ।citāmāropya deham tanmithunam svargamabhyayāt ॥2-64-58॥

translations.english: Having thus cursed me, the couple piteously lamenting for a long time, laid themselves down on the funeral pyre and went to heaven.

verses.sloka: तदेतच्चिन्तयानेन स्मऋतम् पापम् मया स्वयम् ।तदा बाल्यात्कृतम् देवि शब्दवेध्यनुकर्षिणा ॥२-६४-५९॥
verses.transliteration: tadetaccintayānena smaṛtam pāpam mayā svayam ।tadā bālyātkṛtam devi śabdavedhyanukarṣiṇā ॥2-64-59॥

translations.english: While reflecting about it now, O Devi (Kausalya) I recollect this sin committed by me unintentionally, with childish pranks while practising the art of hitting a target by its sound.

verses.sloka: तस्यायम् कर्मणो देवि विपाकः समुपस्थितः ।अपथ्यैः सह सम्भुक्ते व्याधिरन्नरसे यथा ॥२-६४-६०॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāyam karmaṇo devi vipākaḥ samupasthitaḥ ।apathyaiḥ saha sambhukte vyādhirannarase yathā ॥2-64-60॥

translations.english: Just as a man eating forbidden food and drink falls sick, so have I fallen prey to grief, because of my sin, O Devi

verses.sloka: तस्मान् माम् आगतम् भद्रे तस्य उदारस्य तत् वचः ।यद् अहम् पुत्र शोकेन सम्त्यक्ष्याम्य् अद्य जीवितम् ॥२-६४-६१॥
verses.transliteration: tasmān mām āgatam bhadre tasya udārasya tat vacaḥ ।yad aham putra śokena samtyakṣyāmy adya jīvitam ॥2-64-61॥

translations.english: O gentle lady, the words of that noble ascetic have come true today. Hence I am now going to give up my life.

verses.sloka: चक्षुर्भ्याम् त्वाम् न पश्यामि कौसल्ये साधु माम्स्फृश ।इत्युक्त्वा स रुदम्स्त्रस्तो भार्यामाह च भूमिपः ॥२-६४-६२॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣurbhyām tvām na paśyāmi kausalye sādhu māmsphṛśa ।ityuktvā sa rudamstrasto bhāryāmāha ca bhūmipaḥ ॥2-64-62॥

translations.english: O Kausalya, I cannot see you with my eyes. Touch me gently, said the frightened Dasaratha, Lord of the earth, to his wife weeping.

verses.sloka: एतन्मे सदृशम् देवि यन्मया राघवे कृतम् ।सदृशम् तत्तु तस्यैव यदनेन कृतम् मयि ॥२-६४-६३॥
verses.transliteration: etanme sadṛśam devi yanmayā rāghave kṛtam ।sadṛśam tattu tasyaiva yadanena kṛtam mayi ॥2-64-63॥

translations.english: Whatever I have done to the scion of the Raghu family (Rama) is befitting me, O Devi. And whatever he has done in respect of me is also worthy of him.

verses.sloka: दुर्वृत्तमपि कः पुत्रम् त्यजेद्भुवि विचक्षणः ।कश्च प्रव्राज्यमानो वा नासूयेत्पितरम् सुतः ॥२-६४-६४॥
verses.transliteration: durvṛttamapi kaḥ putram tyajedbhuvi vicakṣaṇaḥ ।kaśca pravrājyamāno vā nāsūyetpitaram sutaḥ ॥2-64-64॥

translations.english: Which clearsighted man in this world, will abandon his son even if he is of evil conduct? Which son will not get angry with his father when he is banished?

verses.sloka: यदि माम् सम्स्पृशेद् रामः सकृदद्य लभेत वा ।यमक्षयमनुप्राप्ता द्रक्ष्यन्ति न हि मानवाः ॥२-६४-६५॥
verses.transliteration: yadi mām samspṛśed rāmaḥ sakṛdadya labheta vā ।yamakṣayamanuprāptā drakṣyanti na hi mānavāḥ ॥2-64-65॥

translations.english: Before I die, will Rama touch me once or will he come to me? After reaching the abode of Yama men cannot see their relations.

verses.sloka: चक्षुषा त्वाम् न पश्यामि स्मृतिर् मम विलुप्यते ।दूता वैवस्वतस्य एते कौसल्ये त्वरयन्ति माम् ॥२-६४-६६॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣuṣā tvām na paśyāmi smṛtir mama vilupyate ।dūtā vaivasvatasya ete kausalye tvarayanti mām ॥2-64-66॥

translations.english: O Kausalya, I am unable to see you. My memory is failing and the messengers of Yama are hastening me.

verses.sloka: अतः तु किम् दुह्खतरम् यद् अहम् जीवित क्षये ।न हि पश्यामि धर्मज्ञम् रामम् सत्य पराक्यमम् ॥२-६४-६७॥
verses.transliteration: ataḥ tu kim duhkhataram yad aham jīvita kṣaye ।na hi paśyāmi dharmajñam rāmam satya parākyamam ॥2-64-67॥

translations.english: Can there be a greater sorrow than that at the last moment of my life I am unable to see my righteous and truthful son, Rama?

verses.sloka: तस्यादर्शनजः शोकः सुतस्याप्रतिकर्मणः ।उच्चोषयति मे प्राणान्वारि स्तोकमिवातवः ॥२-६४-६८॥
verses.transliteration: tasyādarśanajaḥ śokaḥ sutasyāpratikarmaṇaḥ ।uccoṣayati me prāṇānvāri stokamivātavaḥ ॥2-64-68॥

translations.english: My grief in the absence of Rama of peerless deeds is drying up my life as heat dries up small pools of water.

verses.sloka: न ते मनुष्या देवाः ते ये चारु शुभ कुण्डलम् ।मुखम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य वर्षे पन्च दशे पुनः ॥२-६४-६९॥
verses.transliteration: na te manuṣyā devāḥ te ye cāru śubha kuṇḍalam ।mukham drakṣyanti rāmasya varṣe panca daśe punaḥ ॥2-64-69॥

translations.english: Those who will behold Rama's countenance adorned with auspicious earrings on his return in the fifteenth year are gods not men.

verses.sloka: पद्म पत्र ईक्षणम् सुभ्रु सुदम्ष्ट्रम् चारु नासिकम् ।धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य तारा अधिप निभम् मुखम् ॥२-६४-७०॥
verses.transliteration: padma patra īkṣaṇam subhru sudamṣṭram cāru nāsikam ।dhanyā drakṣyanti rāmasya tārā adhipa nibham mukham ॥2-64-70॥

translations.english: Blessed are they who will behold Rama's countenance resembling the Moon, lord of the stars with eyes like lotus petals graceful eyebrows, even teeth and a nose.

verses.sloka: सदृशम् शारदस्य इन्दोह् फुल्लस्य कमलस्य च ।सुगन्धि मम नाथस्य धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति तन् मुखम् ॥२-६४-७१॥
verses.transliteration: sadṛśam śāradasya indoh phullasya kamalasya ca ।sugandhi mama nāthasya dhanyā drakṣyanti tan mukham ॥2-64-71॥

translations.english: Fortunate indeed are the men who will behold my son's fragrant countenance camparable to the autmnal Moon and the fullblown lotus.

verses.sloka: निवृत्त वन वासम् तम् अयोध्याम् पुनर् आगतम् ।द्रक्ष्यन्ति सुखिनो रामम् शुक्रम् मार्ग गतम् यथा ॥२-६४-७२॥
verses.transliteration: nivṛtta vana vāsam tam ayodhyām punar āgatam ।drakṣyanti sukhino rāmam śukram mārga gatam yathā ॥2-64-72॥

translations.english: Lucky men will behold Rama return to Ayodhya after the completion of his exile, like the planet Venus moving forward on its orbit.

verses.sloka: कौसल्ये चित्त मोहेन हृदयम् सीदतीव मे ।वेदये न च समुक्तान् शब्दस्पर्शरसानहम् ॥२-६४-७३॥
verses.transliteration: kausalye citta mohena hṛdayam sīdatīva me ।vedaye na ca samuktān śabdasparśarasānaham ॥2-64-73॥

translations.english: O Kausalya, my heart, it appears is sinking and on account of delusion I am not able to feel the sense objects like sound touch and taste together.

verses.sloka: चित्तनाशाद्विपद्यन्ते सर्वाण्येवेन्द्रियाणि मे ।क्षिणस्नेहस्य दीपस्य सम्सक्ता रश्मयो यथा ॥२-६४-७४॥
verses.transliteration: cittanāśādvipadyante sarvāṇyevendriyāṇi me ।kṣiṇasnehasya dīpasya samsaktā raśmayo yathā ॥2-64-74॥

translations.english: With the loss of my mental faculty, all the sense organs are giving way, like the rays of the lamp giving way together when the oil is exhausted.

verses.sloka: अयम् आत्म भवः शोको माम् अनाथम् अचेतनम् ।सम्सादयति वेगेन यथा कूलम् नदी रयः ॥२-६४-७५॥
verses.transliteration: ayam ātma bhavaḥ śoko mām anātham acetanam ।samsādayati vegena yathā kūlam nadī rayaḥ ॥2-64-75॥

translations.english: This selfcreated grief is rapidly destroying me like the bank of a river eroded by its swift current, leaving me helpless and insensible.

verses.sloka: हा राघव महा बाहो हा मम आयास नाशन ।हा पितृप्रिय मे नाथ हाद्य क्वासि गतः सुत ॥२-६४-७६॥
verses.transliteration: hā rāghava mahā bāho hā mama āyāsa nāśana ।hā pitṛpriya me nātha hādya kvāsi gataḥ suta ॥2-64-76॥

translations.english: Ah, mightyarmed Rama, destroyer of my agonies, Ah, the delight of your father, Ah, my protector, Ah, my son, where have you gone?.

verses.sloka: हा कौसल्ये नशिष्यामि हा सुमित्रे तपस्विनि ।हा नृशम्से ममामित्रे कैकेयि कुलपाम्सनि ॥२-६४-७७॥
verses.transliteration: hā kausalye naśiṣyāmi hā sumitre tapasvini ।hā nṛśamse mamāmitre kaikeyi kulapāmsani ॥2-64-77॥

translations.english: Ah, Kausalya, Ah, pitiable Sumitra, Ah, cruel Kaikeyi, my enemy and defiler of my race, I am going to die.

verses.sloka: इति रामस्य मातुश्च सुमित्रायाश्च सन्निधौ ।राजा दशरथः शोचन् जीवित अन्तम् उपागमत् ॥२-६४-७८॥
verses.transliteration: iti rāmasya mātuśca sumitrāyāśca sannidhau ।rājā daśarathaḥ śocan jīvita antam upāgamat ॥2-64-78॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, thus crying in distress in the presence of Rama's mother and Sumitra reached the end of his life.

verses.sloka: यथा तु दीनम् कथयन् नर अधिपः ।प्रियस्य पुत्रस्य विवासन आतुरः ।गते अर्ध रात्रे भृश दुह्ख पीडितः ।तदा जहौ प्राणम् उदार दर्शनः ॥२-६४-७९॥
verses.transliteration: yathā tu dīnam kathayan nara adhipaḥ ।priyasya putrasya vivāsana āturaḥ ।gate ardha rātre bhṛśa duhkha pīḍitaḥ ।tadā jahau prāṇam udāra darśanaḥ ॥2-64-79॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha, a man of noble vision and lord of men, anguished by the exile of his son, kept pitiably muttering till past midnight until tormented by an intense agony he breathed his last. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
